# Infrastructure Development Proposal

This proposal requests funding from the community pool to enhance our network infrastructure for the second quarter of 2025.

## Objectives

- Upgrade server infrastructure
- Implement new monitoring systems
- Enhance security protocols
- Improve network performance

## Timeline

- **Phase 1**: Infrastructure assessment (2 weeks)
- **Phase 2**: Implementation (6 weeks)
- **Phase 3**: Testing and optimization (2 weeks)

## Expected Outcomes

- 50% improvement in network throughput
- Enhanced security monitoring
- Better user experience
- Reduced maintenance costs

## Budget Breakdown

| Item | Amount (GNS) |
|------|-------------|
| Hardware | 150,000 |
| Software Licenses | 50,000 |
| Development | 30,000 |
| Testing & QA | 20,000 |

Thank you for considering this proposal.
